text: This is the Wall of DOPEMIND.
Its signature Cent,
number 478, was struck in 1963.
It carries a significant obsidian patina,
a notable desert patina,
and Speckles, small particles
scattered across the face.
Notable means clearly visible but local,
and significant a major presence on the face.
Speckles is one of the twelve
types of contamination,
foreign matter added after minting.
Number 8741, from 1979,
one of the three Chronicle Set years,
carries two more types at once:
paint, a colored layer,
and obscure adhesive, thick, cloudy deposits.
Only thirteen of the ten thousand
Cents carry two types of contamination.
Together, these two Cents
cover three of the twelve types,
which makes a Contamination Set.
As of November 2026,
fifty-eight collectors hold one.
DOPEMIND holds only two contaminated
Cents, the fewest of any Wall with this Set.
The Wall holds twelve Cents, from 1963 to 1981,
which puts it in the Dime Club,
for ten to twenty-four Cents.
Two of them carry a D mint
mark, for Denver, from 1963
The Wall holds both years
without a mint mark as well.
Number 3396, from 1976, carries white
drips and streaks, pale runs across the patina.
Eighty-two Cents carry them.
And the Wall carries Diamond Hands:
it has held its position for at least
a year, with little to no selling.
Find all of the Collector Walls
on cents.vision under Collectors.
